title: fix: debug badge shows gpu develop of encoded clips

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: debug badge shows gpu develop of encoded clips

description: The editor's debug path badge only knew the surface path, so an encoded clip developed on the GPU (E0b-4b) and shown as a bitmap read CPU. It now reads GPU+bmp in that case (EncodedFrameTrace.gpuDeveloped, reset on close); GPU still means presented through the GPU window.
changed: fix: debug badge shows gpu develop of encoded clips
